Could your thoughts shape the world around you?

Kevin Trudeau shares experiments he says show that thoughts affect physical matter. In one, a glass of water is shown hate, then frozen, and the ice crystal looks jagged. Show another glass love, and the crystal looks beautiful.

He adds that plants played rock music for a month die, while plants played Mozart grow twice as much.

For Kevin, this is why the frequency you put out matters.

What kind of frequency are you broadcasting today?

#ad #mindset #energy

What if the way to get what you want is to stop needing it?

Kevin Trudeau explains his method for letting go of the outcome. Picture yourself not having what you desire, in full detail, and feel how painful it would be. Then run that movie again, and again, and again.

After a while you get tired of it. The charge fades and you start laughing. He says you stop wanting it so desperately.

Once the fear of not getting it is gone, he says, it becomes easy to let go.

What are you holding on to too tightly?
